activity.notes: Nefertiti is securely attested as Akhenaten's Great Royal Wife in the Amarna period. ATLAS uses the c.1353-c.1336 BCE Amarna reign envelope only as a representative activity window and does not assert the disputed identification of Nefertiti with a later co-ruler or pharaoh.
